title: RTC Voice Agent user profile v4
description: Cross-project stable, non-sensitive user traits used to personalize future conversations. Domains are open; relation values are normalized. Legacy v3 preferences are migrated when read.

schema_version.description: Profile schema version owned and validated by this project.

traits.description: Stable cross-project preferences, capabilities, and general tendencies. Temporary choices, project facts, goals, and events belong in long-term memory or are not stored.

domain.description: Open lowercase domain such as food, topic, skill, decision_style, or communication.

relation.description: Normalized relation; direct opposites replace one another for the same domain and subject.
